notes.title: Otto Goes Skiing Is In Greenlight
notes.notes:
So after a lot of indecision over what our second game should be, we've finally pushed our follow-up to [b]Crazy Otto[/b] onto Steam Greenlight.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278650/642daeb43d2a80fceb838426f188ebb6c4bc9994.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=852904102]Otto Goes Skiing[/url] is a game where you and up to three of your friends attempt to win enough money in skiing contests to save your local bar from being bought and demolished by an evil tycoon.

If you enjoyed [b]Crazy Otto[/b], we think you'll enjoy this - it's more arcade multiplayer fun for people of all ages. And it'll launch at [b]Crazy Otto[/b]'s new, lower price!

We'd [i]really[/i] appreciate it if you'd vote Yes for [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=852904102]Otto Goes Skiing[/url] on its Greenlight page - every vote gets us closer to launching our next game!

Thanks for all your support!

notes.title: Public Beta Of New Control Scheme
notes.notes:
Following some reviews and a chat on the discussion board with [b]supersmo[/b], we've started to update the control system to better handle when you're pushing diagonal directions on your controllers. There's a public beta available to try it out, so you can let us know if it's good or bad or broken in some way.

If you haven't opted-in to a game beta before, here's what to do: right-click on [b]Crazy Otto[/b] in your games library and click [i]'Properties'[/i]. Then pick the [i]'Betas'[/i] tab. There you can select the [b]'beta'[/b] branch to opt-in to. Although there's a password box, you don't need a password!

Once you've opted-in to the beta, Steam will update [b]Crazy Otto[/b] with the new version, and then it's ready to go!
